# Domains API

Add a hostname you own, configure the verification CNAME returned by the API, then send Verify domain.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/domain` | [List domains](#op-get-v1-domain) |
| `POST` | `/v1/domain` | [Create domain](#op-post-v1-domain) |
| `GET` | `/v1/domain/{id}` | [Get domain](#op-get-v1-domain-id) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/domain/{id}` | [Update domain](#op-put-v1-domain-id) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/domain/{id}` | [Delete domain](#op-delete-v1-domain-id) |
| `POST` | `/v1/domain/{id}/verify` | [Verify domain](#op-post-v1-domain-id-verify) |

## List domains {#op-get-v1-domain}

`GET /v1/domain`

Returns a paginated list of Domain

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/domain" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of Domain

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].domain_id` | string |  |
| `data[].hostname` | string | User-owned custom hostname; adios.dev and adios.run namespaces are reserved for platform-managed routes |
| `data[].redirect_to` | string | Optional URL or hostname to redirect to (e.g. https://www.adios.dev) |
| `data[].scope` | string | Authorized hostname scope: exact permits only hostname; subtree also permits descendant hostnames. New registrable domains default to subtree, new subdomains default to exact, and existing records remain subtree for backward compatibility. Allowed: exact, subtree. |
| `data[].status` | string | Domain verification status Allowed: pending, verified. |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].verification_hostname` | string | DNS name that must be configured as a CNAME for ownership verification |
| `data[].verification_parent_id` | string | Verified parent domain claim from which this hostname inherited verification; empty for direct DNS verification |
| `data[].verification_value` | string | Expected CNAME value for ownership verification |
| `data[].verified_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].workload_id` | string |  |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

Illustrative example; not a live response:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "created_at": 1791072000,
      "deleted_at": 0,
      "domain_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "hostname": "app.example.com",
      "redirect_to": "example",
      "scope": "exact",
      "status": "pending",
      "team_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "updated_at": 1791072000,
      "verification_hostname": "example",
      "verification_parent_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "verification_value": "example",
      "verified_at": 0,
      "workload_id": "000000000000000000000000001"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 1,
    "total": 1
  }
}
```


## Create domain {#op-post-v1-domain}

`POST /v1/domain`

Creates a new Domain

This request changes data or starts an action. Review the target and body before sending it.

Request fields (the body contains an editable example):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostname` | string | yes | User-owned custom hostname; adios.dev and adios.run namespaces are reserved for platform-managed routes |
| `redirect_to` | string | no | Optional URL or hostname to redirect to (e.g. https://www.adios.dev) |
| `scope` | string | no | Authorized hostname scope: exact permits only hostname; subtree also permits descendant hostnames. New registrable domains default to subtree, new subdomains default to exact, and existing records remain subtree for backward compatibility. Allowed: exact, subtree. |
| `status` | string | no | Domain verification status Allowed: pending, verified. Default: `"pending"`. |
| `team_id` | string | yes |  |
| `verification_hostname` | string | no | DNS name that must be configured as a CNAME for ownership verification |
| `verification_parent_id` | string | no | Verified parent domain claim from which this hostname inherited verification; empty for direct DNS verification |
| `verification_value` | string | no | Expected CNAME value for ownership verification |
| `verified_at` | integer | no | (Unix timestamp) Default: `0`. |
| `workload_id` | string | no |  |

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request POST "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/domain" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "team_id": "YOUR_TEAM_ID",
  "hostname": "YOUR_HOSTNAME"
}
JSON
```

Replace `YOUR_*` body placeholders before sending. The quoted heredoc keeps the JSON literal.

### Response: HTTP 201

Domain created

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `domain_id` | string |  |
| `hostname` | string | User-owned custom hostname; adios.dev and adios.run namespaces are reserved for platform-managed routes |
| `redirect_to` | string | Optional URL or hostname to redirect to (e.g. https://www.adios.dev) |
| `scope` | string | Authorized hostname scope: exact permits only hostname; subtree also permits descendant hostnames. New registrable domains default to subtree, new subdomains default to exact, and existing records remain subtree for backward compatibility. Allowed: exact, subtree. |
| `status` | string | Domain verification status Allowed: pending, verified. |
| `team_id` | string |  |
| `updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `verification_hostname` | string | DNS name that must be configured as a CNAME for ownership verification |
| `verification_parent_id` | string | Verified parent domain claim from which this hostname inherited verification; empty for direct DNS verification |
| `verification_value` | string | Expected CNAME value for ownership verification |
| `verified_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `workload_id` | string |  |

## Verify domain {#op-post-v1-domain-id-verify}

`POST /v1/domain/{id}/verify`

Check the ownership CNAME provided when the domain was created. Configure DNS before sending this request.

Set `domain_id` using IDs from your own API responses.

This request changes data or starts an action. Review the target and body before sending it.

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | yes | Resource identifier from your team's API results. |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request POST "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/domain/${ADIOS_DOMAIN_ID}/verify" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

Successful response. Inspect returned state for operations that start asynchronous work.

A complete response-body schema is not published for this custom operation. Inspect the returned content and status; no payload is assumed here.
